title: 一只猫的肖像 · 编辑基准图
prompt: Create a photorealistic editorial portrait of one fictional adult domestic cat, landscape 3:2. The cat has a distinctive asymmetrical face: mostly cream fur, a charcoal gray patch around its left eye (viewer right), both ears charcoal, pale green eyes, pink nose, cream chest and gray-striped tail curved on the cushion beside it. Sitting upright on a simple oatmeal linen cushion on a light oak window bench, front-facing head slightly angled toward the camera. Soft overcast daylight from the left, warm off-white wall behind, a gently out-of-focus green plant far in the background. Full cat ears, front paws and tail remain visible in frame. Natural fur detail, no over-sharpening, believable paws and whiskers, calm curious expression. No collar, clothing, accessories, text or watermark. This is an original fictional cat created as a reference for a subsequent controlled scarf edit; make its markings and scene clear and stable.
